in_sanskrit.name: Nimika
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Goddess of fertility
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Nimika एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Nimika is a Sanskrit name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Nimisha', which means 'instant'. In Hindu mythology, Nimika is the goddess of fertility and motherhood. She is believed to bless her devotees with abundance and prosperity.
